{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Southwestern cuisine|Southwestern U.S. cuisine]]

Smoky but sweet.

== Ingredients ==
* 1 slab [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] spareribs
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] [[Cookbook:Chipotle BBQ Sauce|Chipotle BBQ Sauce]]
* 6 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] [[Cookbook:Chipotle BBQ Rub|Chipotle BBQ Rub]]
* ¼ cup [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]]
* Hickory chunks

== Procedure ==
#Season ribs with BBQ rub. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour.
#Combine BBQ sauce with molasses.
#Place hickory chunks into a 325–350°F [[Cookbook:Smoker|smoker]] or in a charcoal [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]] set for indirect heat at 325–350°F.
#Place ribs into smoker or grill and cook for 3–4 hours, brushing with molasses mixture often.
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] ribs with remaining sauce and place on a medium-high grill and [[Cookbook:Searing|sear]] until well-browned.
#Let sit for 15 minutes; serve.
